attempts.answer:
Based on official developer and app-store publishing records for **GitMind** at **`gitmind.com`**:

* **Operating Company / Developer:** **Wangxu Technology Co., Ltd.** (also operating and registered as **WangXu Technology (HK) Co., Limited**).
* **Provider Brand:** **GitMind**.

### Evidence
* **Apple App Store:** The official listing for *GitMind: AI Mind Map & Notes* identifies the developer and seller as **Wangxu Technology Co., Ltd.**, directly citing `https://gitmind.com/terms` and `https://gitmind.com/privacy`.
* **Google Play Store:** The official listing for *GitMind: AI Mind Mapping App* identifies the developer as **WangXu Technology (HK) Co., Limited**, listing the official website as `https://gitmind.com`, privacy policy at `https://gitmind.com/privacy`, and contact email as `support@gitmind.com`.
